description:
Job Description: Senior Accounts Manager Location: Sion East
 Employment Type: Full-time
 Reporting To: Founder & Finance Head
 Experience Required: 712 years, preferably in an SME environment Role Purpose The Senior Accounts Manager will manage the companys end-to-end accounting function, including finalisation of accounts, MIS reporting, budgeting, forecasting, compliance coordination, and financial controls. We are looking for a proactive, hands-on professional who is comfortable working in a growing SME and can provide management with accurate financial information for decision-making. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage day-to-day accounting and ensure books of accounts are complete and accurate. Handle monthly, quarterly, and annual finalisation of accounts. Prepare and review Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, cash-flow statements, and supporting schedules. Prepare timely and meaningful MIS reports, including variance analysis and business performance insights. Lead the annual budgeting process and prepare periodic financial forecasts. Monitor actual performance against budgets and explain key deviations. Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, bank reconciliations, and working-capital reporting. Monitor cash flows and support fund-planning decisions. Ensure timely compliance with GST, TDS, income tax, and other applicable statutory requirements. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, banks, and other external stakeholders. Strengthen accounting processes, internal controls, documentation, and reporting systems. Identify financial risks, process gaps, cost-saving opportunities, and corrective actions. Guide and review the work of the accounts team. Provide financial information and analysis to management for business decisions. 
 Required Skills and Experience Bachelors or Master’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance. CA Inter, CMA Inter, or a similar professional qualification would be preferred. 5-7 years of relevant accounting and finance experience. Strong hands-on experience in finalisation of accounts. Experience preparing MIS reports, budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses. Sound knowledge of Indian accounting practices and statutory compliances. Proficiency in Tally or another ERP/accounting system. Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Experience managing audits and coordinating with external consultants. Ability to supervise and develop an accounts team. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Candidate Profile Proactive and able to identify issues before they become problems. Comfortable working in a hands-on, fast-moving SME environment. Willing to manage both operational accounting and management reporting. Commercially aware and able to look beyond accounting entries to understand business impact. Organised, dependable, and committed to meeting reporting deadlines. Interested in building systems and processes as the organisation grows. Demonstrates ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and confidentiality. Success Measures The successful candidate will be measured on: Timely and accurate monthly and annual closing of accounts. Quality and usefulness of MIS reports provided to management. Accuracy of budgets, forecasts, and variance explanations. Timely completion of audits and statutory compliances. Improvement in cash-flow visibility and working-capital monitoring. Reduction in accounting errors, unreconciled balances, and reporting delays. Strengthening of financial controls, processes, and team capability.

title: Tally Operator
description:
An established company in Ghatkopar West is looking for a reliable, organised, and detail-oriented Tally Data Entry Operator to assist with day-to-day accounting, billing, and record-keeping activities. 
 The candidate will be responsible for entering financial transactions into Tally, maintaining accurate sales and purchase records, tracking customer payments and outstanding balances, and supporting routine accounting and administrative work. 
 The ideal candidate should have working knowledge of Tally, basic accounting principles, and MS Excel, with a strong focus on accuracy, timely data entry, and proper documentation. 
 Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Tally & Daily Accounting Enter daily sales, purchase, receipt, payment, expense, journal, and other relevant vouchers in Tally. Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records and ledgers. Prepare and record invoices, bills, receipts, payment vouchers, and credit/debit notes as required. Verify entries against supporting documents and ensure correct amounts, dates, party details, and ledger classifications. Identify discrepancies or missing information and bring them to the attention of the accountant or proprietor.

Assist with bank statement reconciliation, including cheque, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, and other transactions, wherever applicable. Maintain petty cash records and supporting expense vouchers. Report any cash differences, duplicate entries, or unexplained discrepancies promptly. 
 3. Sales, Billing & Customer Accounts Prepare sales bills and invoices for gas sales and other applicable transactions. Maintain customer-wise sales and payment records. Record cash, bank, UPI, and other customer collections accurately. Track outstanding payments and maintain records of customer dues and advances. Assist with payment follow-ups and resolve basic billing or account-entry discrepancies in coordination with the concerned staff. 
 Required Qualifications & Skills Minimum HSC (12th pass); a commerce background or B.Com qualification is preferred. Practical working knowledge of Tally Prime or Tally ERP. title: Assistant Manager / Manager - Direct Tax
description:
Role & responsibilities Job Description 
 Department: Direct Taxation Advisory & Regulatory Services
 Job Title: Assistant Manager / Manager
 Location: Mumbai Nariman Point
 Reporting To: Senior Manager / Partner 
 Experience & Qualification Chartered Accountant (CA). Minimum 3 years of post-qualification experience in direct taxation, with exposure to direct tax litigation, appellate proceedings, and representation. Articleship experience with a mid-sized or large CA firm; prior experience with a professional services firm is preferred. Key Competencies Strong technical knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 1961, applicable rules, and relevant judicial precedents. Excellent drafting, legal research, analytical, communication, and presentation skills. Ability to prepare high-quality written submissions, grounds of appeal, paper books, and legal briefs. Proactive, self-driven, detail-oriented, and result-oriented approach, with the ability to work effectively in a team. Proficiency in electronic tax filings, documentation, research tools, and computerised working environments. Key Responsibilities 1. Direct Tax Litigation, Appeals & Representation Draft, review, and prepare appeals, grounds of appeal, statements of facts, written submissions, paper books, and supporting documentation for proceedings before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) [CIT(A)] and the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT). Handle appellate matters under both the Faceless Appeal Scheme and before jurisdictional appellate authorities. Conduct detailed legal research on complex tax issues, analyse judicial precedents, and develop arguments and litigation strategies for appellate matters. Prepare submissions and responses for assessment, reassessment, penalty, stay, and prosecution proceedings, including matters arising from search and seizure operations. Assist in briefing Managers, Partners, and Senior Counsels for matters before CIT(A), ITAT, High Courts, and the Supreme Court, including preparation of case summaries, paper books, and compilation of relevant judicial precedents. Support representation before income-tax authorities and appellate forums, including coordination of hearings, filing of submissions, and follow-up on proceedings. Monitor litigation matters, track deadlines, and assist in evaluating tax demands, potential exposures, and appropriate legal remedies. 2. Assessment Proceedings & Direct Tax Compliance Draft submissions and responses to notices, queries, and requisitions issued by the Assessing Officer and other income-tax authorities. Assist in assessment, reassessment, transfer pricing assessment, and other regulatory proceedings. Prepare, review, and file income-tax returns and TDS returns for individuals, HUFs, partnership firms, and companies. Respond to departmental notices and ensure timely compliance with statutory requirements. Review tax audit reports and assist in other direct tax compliance, certification, and filing requirements. 3. Transfer Pricing & International Taxation Prepare and review transfer pricing study reports, including conducting Functional, Asset and Risk (FAR) interviews and analysing comparable companies and transactions. Assist in transfer pricing assessments and proceedings before the Transfer Pricing Officer (TPO). Prepare and review Form No. 3CEB, inter-company agreements, and transfer pricing documentation. Assist in the preparation of Advance Pricing Agreement (APA) pre-filing applications and applications, including rollback provisions. Undertake Base Erosion and Profit Shifting (BEPS) analysis and assist with Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) and Master File compliances. Advise on domestic and international tax issues, including cross-border transactions, Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs), Multilateral Instruments (MLIs), permanent establishment exposure, inbound and outbound taxation, and repatriation of funds. Prepare and review Form 15CA/15CB and analyse withholding tax implications for domestic and cross-border transactions. 4. Tax Advisory, Structuring & Planning Assist in providing advisory on domestic taxation, international taxation, corporate tax, and transfer pricing matters. Evaluate the tax implications of business transactions, corporate structures, and proposed arrangements. Support tax planning and structuring assignments, including identifying tax risks and evaluating available tax positions. Assist in preparing technical opinions, advisory notes, client responses, and research memoranda on complex tax matters. 5. Client Management & Practice Development Support Partners and Managers in day-to-day assignments, client deliverables, and resolution of technical tax queries. Coordinate with clients to obtain information, understand transaction details, and ensure timely completion of assignments. Contribute to technical updates by tracking amendments to tax laws, reviewing professional publications, and analysing relevant judicial pronouncements. Assist in preparing proposals, client presentations, engagement documents, and other practice development materials. Tools & Software

title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
Position Title: Equity Fundamental Research Analyst Department: Institutional Equity Research (Sell Side) Reporting to: Head of Research / Senior Analyst Location: Andheri (Chakala), Mumbai Head Office Company Profile: LKP Securities Ltd. is a leading financial services provider in India. Established in 1948, the company has a rich history of offering a wide range of services including equity and commodity broking, financial planning, investment advisory, wealth management, and research. LKP Securities has a strong presence in major Indian cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Surat, Pune, Nashik. The company is known for its robust risk management practices and cutting-edge technology platforms that enable seamless trading and investment processes for its clients. With a team of experienced professionals, LKP Securities is committed to delivering quality services to individual and institutional investors. The company's research division provides in-depth analysis and market insights, allowing clients to make informed investment decisions. 
 Key Responsibilities: Build and maintain detailed financial models (P&L, balance sheet, ratio analysis, valuation) for companies under coverage. Prepare initiating coverage reports, quarterly result updates, sector thematic notes, and event-based notes. Track quarterly results, management commentary, concalls, and investor presentations of companies under coverage and translate them into actionable research notes. Monitor RBI, IRDAI, SEBI, and other regulatory developments. Build and update earnings estimates, target prices, and investment ratings (Buy/Hold/Sell) based on fundamental analysis. Attend management meetings, industry conferences, and channel checks to build a differentiated view. Support the institutional sales team and dealers with stock-specific and sector-specific inputs for client interactions. Participate in client calls, roadshows, and marketing of research ideas to institutional investors (FIIs/DIIs/domestic funds). Coordinate with Compliance to ensure all research reports adhere to SEBI Research Analyst regulations and internal review processes. Track peer companies, competitive positioning, and cross-sector read-throughs. Maintain and update sector databases, valuation summary sheets, and comparative company matrices on a regular basis. Stay updated on macro-economic indicators (interest rates, credit growth, asset quality trends).
 Key Skills & Competencies: Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques (DCF, P/E, P/B, P/BV, embedded value for insurance, etc.). Strong analytical and quantitative skills with high attention to detail. Excellent report writing and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate a clear investment thesis. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and financial databases (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Ace Equity, or similar). Good understanding of SEBI Research Analyst regulations and sell-side research compliance requirements. Strong communication skills to interact with company managements, institutional clients, and internal sales teams. Ability to work under tight timelines, particularly during quarterly result seasons. Strong analytical and commercial acumen. Qualifications & Experience: Graduate / Postgraduate in Finance, Economics, Commerce, or related discipline. MBA Finance, CFA, or CA (completed or pursuing) will be preferred. 5-10 years of relevant experience in equity research. Prior sell-side research experience preferred; buy-side or credit research experience. NISM Research Analyst certification preferred (or willingness to acquire). Proven ability to independently track a sector, build financial models, and deliver research output within tight timelines.

Key Skills: Equity Research Analysis,Auto Ancillary,Research,SIDE,Equity analysis,Analysis,Fundamental research,Equity research

title: AMP Regional Manager
description:
Regional Manager (Earthmoving & Mining Equipment spare parts and attachments) Position Summary We are looking for a dynamic and passionate Spare Parts Sales Professional to drive sales growth across the assigned territory through direct customer engagement and dealer network development. The role involves promoting and selling high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment, identifying business opportunities, building strong customer relationships, driving the sales team and achieving sales targets. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge of heavy equipment spare parts, excellent communication skills, and a growth-oriented mindset with a passion for aftermarket sales. Qualification & Experience Educational Qualification Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in: Mechanical Engineering Automobile Engineering Related Engineering Discipline Experience Minimum 15 years of experience in spare parts sales within the: Construction Equipment (CE) Industry Earthmoving Equipment Industry Mining Equipment Industry CE/Mining aftermarket Industry. Proven experience in team handling , direct customer sales and territory management. Experience in aftermarket parts sales and dealer management preferred. Technical Skills Good working knowledge of: Microsoft Excel Microsoft Word Microsoft PowerPoint Hands-on experience with: SAP ERP Other ERP platforms (added advantage) Key Roles & Responsibilities Sales & Business Development Lead and support the team across the assigned territory while effectively engaging with prospective and existing customers to achieve business objectives. Conduct regular customer visits, sales calls, and business reviews to generate sales opportunities. Promote and sell high-quality spare parts for earthmoving, construction, and mining equipment. Prepare and present sales proposals highlighting product benefits, reliability, and value proposition. Identify market opportunities and develop strategies to increase market penetration and revenue growth. Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Customer Relationship Management Build, maintain, and strengthen relationships with key customer accounts, fleet owners, contractors, mining companies, and dealers. Understand customer requirements and provide suitable spare parts solutions. Develop long-term partnerships through exceptional customer service and technical support. Handle customer inquiries, quotations, and follow-ups effectively. Market Development Increase market share by identifying competitor activities and developing growth strategies. Expand customer base and generate new business opportunities. Gather market intelligence, customer feedback, and industry trends to support business decisions. Product Promotion & Customer Education Educate customers on the advantages, quality, performance, and value of our spare parts offerings. Conduct product demonstrations and technical discussions with customers and dealers. Promote preventive maintenance and parts replacement programs that add value to the customer's operations. Reporting & System Management Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, sales pipelines, quotations, and business opportunities. Use SAP and Tuffex Stores Management System for: Quotations Order processing Inventory checks Lead tracking Customer data management Sales reporting Prepare periodic sales reports and territory performance updates. Desired Candidate Profile Passionate about Spare Parts Sales and Aftermarket Business . Strong customer focus with excellent relationship-building skills. Proven team handling skills. Self-driven, result-oriented, and proactive approach to business development. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to work independently and thrive in a target-driven environment. Growth mindset with a commitment to expanding market share and business profitability. Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory. Key Competencies Spare Parts Sales
 Territory Management and team management
 Customer Relationship Management
 Mining & Construction Equipment Knowledge
 Business Development
 SAP / ERP Systems
 Dealer Management
 Negotiation & Presentation Skills
 Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis
 Growth Mindset & Customer Centricity Passion for Spare Parts, Customer Success, and Business Growth is essential for this role. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The performance of the Regional Manager will be measured against the following Key Performance Indicators: Sales & Revenue Performance Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets. Revenue growth from assigned territory. Gross margin achievement against budget. Year-on-year business growth percentage. Customer Acquisition & Retention Number of new customers acquired per quarter. Customer retention rate and repeat business. Growth in business from existing customer accounts. Number of active customer accounts in the territory. Market Development Recruit experienced team to ensure adequate coverage. Increase in market share within assigned territory. Penetration of new geographic areas and customer segments. Conversion rate of identified sales opportunities into orders. Competitive account conversions and business wins. Customer Engagement Number of customer/dealer visits and meetings conducted per month. Number of sales calls completed versus planned. Customer satisfaction and relationship management scores. Timely resolution of customer inquiries and complaints. Lead Management & Pipeline Development Number of qualified leads generated each month. Value of sales pipeline maintained. Lead-to-order conversion ratio. Follow-up closure effectiveness on quotations submitted. Quotation & Order Management Number and value of quotations submitted. Quotation-to-order conversion percentage. Order booking value versus target. Accuracy and timeliness of quotations and order processing. Reporting Compliance Timely and accurate updating of customer activities. Submission of weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales reports on time. Accuracy of sales forecasts and demand planning inputs. Inventory & Product Focus Promotion of strategic and fast-moving spare parts. Sales growth of focus product categories. Support in reducing non-moving inventory through sales initiatives. Identification of stocking opportunities with key customers. Dealer & Channel Development Recruit capable dealers to cover and scale up the business. Dealer sales growth in assigned territory. Dealer engagement and training programs conducted. Dealer coverage and account performance improvement. Achievement of channel partner sales objectives. Success Metrics for the Role Achieve 100%+ Sales Target attainment. Deliver 25-30% annual business growth in assigned territory. Increase market share and customer penetration year-on-year. Maintain high customer retention and satisfaction levels . Generate sustainable growth through new customer acquisition expansion of existing accounts and new business ventures. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong passion for Spare Parts Sales, team handling, customer relationship management, territory expansion, and aftermarket business growth in the Earthmoving, Construction Equipment, and Mining industries.

title: Walk-in || Technical Growth Officer
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 23 Oct - 06 Nov
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Ground Floor, Sr. No. 70, Purushottam Villa, 2B/1, Santkrupa Path, Sinhgad Rd, Vadgaon Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 411041
Contact: Payal Kathole (8080526940)

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Technical Growth Officer 
 Position Overview 
The Technical Growth Officer will be responsible for generating business through technical sales, site visits, customer development, product demonstrations, technical support, and project lead generation .
The role combines technical knowledge with business development and requires the employee to understand customer/site requirements, recommend suitable products and systems, coordinate with internal technical teams, and support the conversion of enquiries into orders.
The Technical Growth Officer will primarily work in the field and develop relationships with customers, contractors, applicators, architects, consultants, builders, developers, industries, and project teams .

 1. Position Details 
 ParticularDetailsDesignation Technical Growth Officer Department Technical Growth / Business Development Reporting To Senior Technical Growth Officer / Project Growth Manager Experience 15 Years Location Assigned Territory Job Type Full-Time Travel Regular field/site travel Industry Preference Waterproofing / Industrial Coatings / Epoxy Flooring / PU Flooring / Construction Chemicals / Technical Sales
 2. Primary Objective 
To generate qualified technical business opportunities, understand customer requirements, provide suitable technical solutions, and support the sales team in converting opportunities into profitable orders.
 Core Responsibility 
 Lead Generation Customer Visit Site Inspection Requirement Understanding Product Recommendation Technical Presentation Quotation Support Follow-Up Order Conversion 

 3. Key Responsibilities 
 A. Technical Business Development 
 Generate new leads through field visits and technical networking. Identify customers requiring waterproofing, flooring, coatings, and construction chemical solutions. Understand customer problems and recommend suitable solutions. Support the sales team with technical inputs. Develop new customers within the assigned territory. Generate project and industrial leads. Identify opportunities for repeat and additional business. Maintain a continuous pipeline of technical opportunities. 
 4. Lead Generation 
Generate leads through:
 Direct market visits Industrial visits Construction sites Contractors Applicators Architects Consultants Builders and developers Existing customers References Dealers/distributors Exhibitions Website enquiries IndiaMART/B2B portals Digital marketing leads All qualified leads must be entered into the company's CRM/system.

 5. Site Visit & Requirement Assessment 
 Visit customer/project sites. Understand site conditions and customer requirements. Identify waterproofing, flooring, coating, leakage, corrosion, insulation, or construction chemical requirements. Take site measurements and photographs where required. Collect technical information. Identify application challenges. Discuss initial technical solutions with the customer. Prepare site visit reports. Coordinate with Senior Technical/Technical Team for complex requirements. 
 6. Product & System Knowledge 
The Technical Growth Officer should develop working knowledge of company products and systems such as:
 Waterproofing 
 PU waterproofing Cementitious waterproofing Crystalline waterproofing Waterproofing membranes Terrace waterproofing Basement waterproofing Joint and crack treatment Flooring 
 Epoxy flooring PU flooring Self-leveling flooring Heavy-duty industrial flooring Anti-skid flooring Protective Coatings 
 Anti-corrosion coatings Industrial protective coatings Heat-insulation coatings Fire-retardant coatings Electrical insulation coatings Construction Chemicals 
 Tile adhesives Epoxy grouts Sealants Repair products Bonding agents Surface treatment products The employee must understand where, why, and how each product/system is used.

 7. Technical Product Presentation 
 Explain product features and applications to customers. Conduct basic technical presentations. Explain product benefits and application procedures. Provide technical datasheets and product information. Conduct product demonstrations when required. Coordinate sample and trial applications. Explain the difference between company systems and competitor solutions. Support product awareness activities. 
 8. Consultant & Architect Visits 
 Visit architects and consultants regularly. Introduce company products and systems. Explain technical applications. Provide product literature and technical documents. Identify specification opportunities. Understand upcoming projects. Develop long-term technical relationships. Maintain consultant visit records. 
 9. Contractor & Applicator Development 
 Identify active contractors and applicators. Develop relationships with them. Understand their project requirements. Introduce suitable products and systems. Coordinate product demonstrations and training. Generate leads through contractor networks. Support contractors during initial product application. Maintain contractor database. 
 10. Customer Handling 
 Conduct regular customer meetings. Understand customer technical and commercial requirements. Provide initial technical guidance. Coordinate with senior technical personnel where required. Maintain professional communication. Follow up after site visits and technical discussions. Collect customer feedback. Identify additional business opportunities. 
 11. Technical Coordination 
Coordinate with:
 Customer Sales Technical Team R&D Estimation Project Team 
Responsibilities include:
 Sharing site information. Sharing customer requirements. Coordinating site inspections. Arranging samples. Coordinating product trials. Supporting technical approvals. Providing technical inputs for quotations. Supporting project handover. Escalating technical issues. 
 12. Quotation Support 
 Understand basic project requirements and BOQ. Provide technical information to the estimation/commercial team. Support preparation of quotations. Ensure the correct product/system is quoted. Follow up on quotations. Coordinate quotation revisions. Inform senior team members about customer feedback and competitor pricing. Support the sales team during negotiations. 
 13. Lead Follow-Up & Conversion 
The employee must maintain strict follow-up on every qualified opportunity.
 Follow-up process: 
 Lead 

 Qualification 

 Customer Meeting 

 Site Visit 

 Technical Requirement 

 Product Recommendation 

 Sample/Trial 

 Quotation 

 Follow-Up 

 Order 
Every opportunity must have a defined next action and expected timeline .

 14. Business Growth Responsibilities 
The Technical Growth Officer is not only a technical support role.
The employee is expected to:
 Generate new business leads. Develop new customers. Generate project enquiries. Support technical approvals. Develop consultants and contractors. Generate product trials. Convert enquiries into orders. Support achievement of sales targets. Generate repeat business. Cross-sell and up-sell suitable products. 
 15. Project Support 
 Identify project opportunities. Collect project information. Coordinate with project sales teams. Support site inspections. Provide technical inputs. Support product trials. Assist in technical meetings. Support project handover after order confirmation. Assist project teams in resolving initial technical queries. 
 16. Customer Complaint Support 
 Understand customer complaints related to product/application. Visit the site when required. Collect photographs and technical information. Report the issue to the senior technical team. Coordinate corrective action. Follow up until resolution. Maintain complaint records. Communicate professionally with customers. 
 17. Daily Field Activity 
The employee is expected to maintain productive field activity including:
 Customer visits Site visits Contractor meetings Consultant meetings Architect meetings New project identification Lead generation Technical presentations Product demonstrations Product trials Quotation follow-ups Business follow-ups Activity quality, lead quality, conversion, and revenue contribution will be evaluatednot only the number of visits. 

 18. CRM & Reporting 
 100% CRM/reporting discipline is mandatory. 
The employee must update:
 New leads Customer information Project details Site visits Technical requirements Product recommendations Samples Trials Quotations Follow-ups Expected order date Expected order value Competitor information Lost opportunity reasons Order status Complaint status Daily Report 
 Customer meetings Site visits New leads Technical discussions Follow-ups Quotations Expected business Weekly Report 
 Lead pipeline Project opportunities Target vs. achievement Site visit summary Consultant development Contractor development Product trials Conversion status Pending technical issues Next-week action plan 
 19. KPI & Performance Measurement 
 KPIMeasurementSales/Revenue Contribution Target vs. Actual Technical Leads Qualified leads generated New Customers New active customers Project Leads Qualified projects identified Site Visits Productive visits Customer Meetings Productive meetings Technical Presentations Presentations conducted Product Trials Trials conducted & converted Quotation Conversion Quotations converted into orders Consultant Development Active consultant relationships Contractor Development Active contractor relationships Repeat Business Repeat order value Complaint Resolution Timely technical support CRM Compliance 100% timely reporting Follow-Up Discipline All qualified leads followed up
 20. Required Technical Skills 
The candidate should have basic-to-good knowledge of:
 Waterproofing systems Epoxy flooring PU flooring Industrial coatings Anti-corrosion coatings Construction chemicals Surface preparation Crack/joint treatment Application methodology BOQ basics Site inspection Basic estimation Technical documentation 
 21. Required Business Skills 
 Lead generation Technical sales Customer acquisition Field sales Project business development Follow-up Negotiation Customer relationship management Basic commercial understanding Business conversion 
 22. Required Personal Competencies 
 Strong communication Good technical understanding Positive attitude Target-oriented Proactive approach Strong follow-up Ownership mindset Good presentation skills Problem-solving ability Willingness to travel Good reporting discipline Team coordination Professional customer handling 
 23. Educational Qualification 
Preferred:
 Diploma / Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Technology, or related field . Additional qualification in Sales & Marketing will be an advantage. 
 24. Experience 
Preferred:
 15 years of experience Technical sales/business development experience preferred. Fresh Civil Engineering candidates with strong communication and field-sales aptitude may also be considered. Experience in waterproofing, flooring, industrial coatings, construction chemicals, or related industries will be an advantage. 
 25. Ideal Candidate Profile 
The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented technical professional with a strong interest in business development .
The candidate should be:
 Technically curious Strong in customer interaction Comfortable visiting sites Good at understanding customer problems Good at explaining technical solutions Strong in follow-up Target-oriented Willing to travel Proactive in generating leads Good at building contractor/consultant relationships Capable of learning products quickly Focused on converting technical interactions into business 
 26. Career Progression 
 Technical Growth Trainee / Executive 

 Technical Growth Officer 

 Senior Technical Growth Officer 

 Project Growth Manager 

 Senior Project Growth Manager 

 Regional Growth & Operations Head State 

 Zonal Growth & Operations Head 

 Chief Growth Officer 

 PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITY 
 The Technical Growth Officer is responsible for creating business opportunities through technical knowledge and field engagement. 
 Lead Generation + Site Visits + Technical Assessment + Product Recommendation + Customer/Consultant/Contractor Development + Product Demonstration + Quotation Support + Follow-Up + Order Conversion + Project Support 
The role must focus on both technical excellence and business generation . Every site visit and technical interaction should contribute toward building the sales pipeline and generating measurable business.

By developing these materials and undertaking various analyses, the role aims to deliver by strengthening the value of the Company to its investors and serving as a catalyst to improve strategic and financial decision making.
 Support the Investor Relations function in driving a strong valuation premium for Company through effective communication of the Company's strategy, business performance, and long-term vision to investors, analysts, and other external stakeholders.

Support statutory, internal and tax audits. Ensure timely month-end closure of taxation and AP-related accounts.

title: Accounts And Inventory Executive
description:
1. Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for an Accounts & Inventory Executive who will be responsible for maintaining accurate records of the Company's inventory and material movements, co-coordinating dispatches and repairs, and supporting the Company's accounting and documentation requirements. The ideal candidate should be highly organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working with large volumes of material and transaction records. The candidate should have strong coordination and follow-up skills and be capable of independently tracking material from the time it is received until it is dispatched, installed, returned, sent for repair or otherwise disposed of/closed. Skills & Qualifications Strong working knowledge of Tally and MS Excel is mandatory. Prior experience in accounts, inventory management, stock control, stores, logistics coordination or a similar role will be preferred. Good understanding of inventory records and stock reconciliation. Strong numerical and analytical skills. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. Good documentation and record-maintenance skills. Ability to coordinate effectively with Service Teams, Clients, Vendors, Logistics Partners and internal departments . Ability to independently track multiple items/materials and their respective status. Should be comfortable maintaining physical as well as digital records. Ability to identify discrepancies in stock and material records and bring them to the attention of management. Key Attributes High degree of accuracy and attention to detail Strong ownership and accountability Good follow-up discipline Systematic approach to record keeping Ability to reconcile and identify discrepancies Ability to manage multiple material movements simultaneously Proactive approach to resolving pending RMAs, repairs and dispatches Good coordination and communication skills 2. Role and Responsibilities A. Inventory & Stock Management Maintain accurate records of all inventory and material held by the Company. Maintain records of all inward and outward movement of material . Conduct regular stock tallying and reconciliation between physical stock and system records. Identify and report discrepancies between physical inventory and recorded inventory. Generate monthly stock reports for management. Maintain proper records of new, standby, faulty, returned, repaired and other equipment. Track the movement and status of individual equipment/material wherever required. Ensure that inventory records are updated promptly following every inward, outward, transfer, return or other material movement. B. RMA & Repair Management Manage the Company's RMA (Return Material Authorization) / repair process from initiation to closure. Coordinate with the Service Department regarding equipment requiring repair. Coordinate with clients regarding material/equipment being returned or sent for repair. Coordinate with repair vendors for receipt, inspection, repair and return of equipment. Maintain complete records of all equipment sent to and received from repair vendors. Track the status of pending repairs and follow up with vendors until closure. Ensure that repaired/replaced equipment is properly recorded and returned to the appropriate stock or service location. Maintain records of faulty equipment, repair history and final disposition. C. Dispatch & Logistics Management Manage and coordinate dispatches of material/equipment to clients, service sites, vendors and other locations. Prepare Delivery Challans and other required dispatch documentation. Coordinate with logistics/courier partners for timely dispatch and delivery. Track shipments and maintain records of dispatch and delivery status. Follow up on delayed, undelivered or returned shipments. Maintain proper records of all dispatched material until delivery/receipt is confirmed. D. Material Movement & Documentation Maintain complete and accurate records of all inward and outward material . Track the movement of standby, new, faulty, repaired and replacement equipment . Maintain all necessary inventory, dispatch, RMA and material-movement registers. Ensure that every movement of material is supported by appropriate documentation. Maintain records of material issued to and returned by Service Engineers/Service Department. Ensure timely updating of Tally/Excel and other relevant records following material movement. E. Coordination with Service Department, Clients & Vendors Coordinate end-to-end with the Service Department regarding material requirements, returns, faulty equipment, standby equipment and repairs. Coordinate with clients regarding material dispatches, returns, replacements and repair-related requirements. Coordinate with repair vendors for equipment movement and repair status. Follow up with all relevant parties to ensure that material movement and repair activities are completed within the required timelines. Escalate delays, discrepancies or unresolved issues to the appropriate authority. F. Accounts & Record Management Maintain accurate records in Tally and Excel relating to inventory and material transactions. Ensure that relevant inventory and material records are properly reconciled. Assist in maintaining supporting documentation for inventory-related accounting records. Maintain all necessary registers, reports and supporting documents in an organized manner. Prepare periodic reports relating to stock, material movement, pending repairs, RMAs and dispatches as required by management. G. Reporting & Control Prepare and submit the monthly stock report to management. Prepare reports on: Stock position Stock discrepancies Pending RMAs Material under repair Material dispatched Material pending receipt Standby equipment Faulty equipment Other material movements as required Ensure that all outstanding material movements and pending RMAs are regularly reviewed and followed up. Maintain proper documentation so that the location and status of Company equipment/material can be identified at any time. 
 * MALE ONLY*

Prepare management dashboards showing Budget vs Actual vs Previous Period with reason for Increase in Cost compared to Budget. 3. Budgeting & MIS Assist management in preparing annual operating budgets. Establish cost budgets for departments and business verticals. Conduct monthly budget variance analysis. title: Costing & Cost Optimization Manager /Senior Management Cost Accountant
description:
Company: Private Limited Company TPA / Healthcare Service Experience: 1015 years
 Qualification: Cost Accountant / MBA Finance candidates with strong costing and financial analysis experience Reporting To: Managing Director 
 About the Role We are looking for a highly analytical and commercially oriented Costing & Cost Optimization professional including MIS & Budgeting who can independently analyze the Company's costs, identify unnecessary expenditure, recommend cost-saving measures. 
 The role will cover the Company's operations, various business verticals, corporate expenses and promoter-related expenses incurred through the Company as well as expenses maintained in private books, for management analysis. 
 The primary responsibility is to establish appropriate cost benchmarks and continuously identify opportunities to reduce costs without adversely affecting business operations or regulatory/service requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Costing & MIS Independently analyse the Company's cost structure on a monthly basis. Prepare detailed business-wise, department-wise, location-wise and activity-wise costing. Analyse fixed costs, variable costs, manpower costs, technology costs, vendor costs, administrative costs and other operating expenses. Identify cost overruns and investigate the reasons for deviations from budget. Develop appropriate cost-per-transaction / cost-per-claim / cost-per-employee / cost-per-service metrics for TPA operations. Analyse profitability and contribution margins of different business segments, clients and projects. Identify loss-making clients/contracts/business activities and recommend corrective action. Prepare management dashboards showing Budget vs Actual vs Previous Period vs Target. 2. Promoter / Management Expense Analysis Analyse expenses incurred through the Company which relate to promoters/management and provide clear classification and reporting. Review expenses maintained in private books for management-level cost analysis wherever required. Prepare consolidated management analysis of relevant Company and private expenses with comparison with Budget and Actual. Identify avoidable expenditure and opportunities for better allocation/control. Establish appropriate approval and documentation mechanisms for management/promoter-related expenses. Prepare management dashboards showing Budget vs Actual vs Previous Period with reason for Increase in Cost compared to Budget. 3. Budgeting & MIS Assist management in preparing annual operating budgets. Establish cost budgets for departments and business verticals. Conduct monthly budget variance analysis. Highlight significant adverse variances with reasons and corrective action. Develop rolling forecasts for major expense categories. 
 Candidate Profile 
 10–15 years of relevant experience in costing, management accounting, financial analysis, cost control, FP&A, business finance or cost optimization. Cost Account who handles above work will be preferred. Strong experience in cost analysis and cost reduction is more important than routine accounting experience. Experience in a service industry, healthcare, insurance, TPA, BPO, technology or transaction-processing business will be an advantage. Strong Excel skills are essential. Experience with Power BI / MIS / financial modelling will be an advantage. Must be commercially minded and capable of challenging unnecessary expenditure. Should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Should be comfortable interacting with senior management and business heads. 
 Most Important Requirement 
 The candidate should have the mindset: “Don't just report the cost – find out why it is being incurred, determine whether it is necessary, identify how it can be reduced, implement the solution and prove the saving.” The successful candidate will be measured substantially on actual cost reduction, improved productivity and measurable financial savings, and not merely on preparation of MIS reports. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Actual annual cost savings achieved. Percentage reduction in controllable operating costs. Reduction in cost per transaction/claim. Budget adherence. Reduction in recurring unnecessary expenses. Improvement in manpower productivity. Vendor cost reduction. Implementation rate of approved cost-saving initiatives. Accuracy of costing and profitability analysis. Timeliness and quality of management MIS. ROI achieved from automation/process improvement initiatives. 
 Candidates who have demonstrated significant cost reduction / turnaround / profitability improvement in their previous organizations will be given preference.

title: Accounting Intern
description:
Accounts Intern | Job Description & Scope of Work 

 Position:- Accounts Intern Department:- Finance & Accounts Reports to Accounts Manager / Finance Head Employment type:- Internship (duration and stipend as per HR policy) Preferred qualification:- B.Com / M.Com / accounting or finance 
 student or recent graduate Role objective Support accurate and timely accounting operations, GST and ledger reconciliations, Zoho Books data management, project expense reporting and month-end closing under supervision. 
Key responsibilities
1. Accounts payable and daily bookkeeping
 Collect and validate purchase invoices against PO/GRN where applicable; check invoice details, GSTIN, tax and duplicates. Compile and categorise employee expenses and supporting bills; flag missing approvals. Prepare routine invoice entries in Zoho Books for authorised review and posting. 2. Vendor, customer and bank reconciliation
 Reconcile vendor and customer ledgers, credit/debit notes, payments and advances. Prepare vendor/customer outstanding and ageing reports; flag old or unexplained items. Match bank transactions with books and prepare bank reconciliation exception lists. 3. GST and TDS support
 Match purchase register with GSTR-2B supplier-wise and tax-head-wise (CGST, SGST, IGST). Maintain mismatch, missing invoice and supplier follow-up trackers. Compile GST and TDS working papers, deduction summaries and supporting records for review. 4. Zoho Books and Tally migration support
 Review vendor/customer master completeness, duplicate records and ledger classifications. Match approved Tally balances with Zoho opening balances, open AR/AP and advances. Prepare migration discrepancy logs; do not independently amend approved opening balances. 5. Solar EPC and project accounting support
 Compile project-wise material, labour, freight, travel and other cost records. Compare PO values with vendor bills and receipts; track advances and adjustments. Prepare draft project expense and budget-versus-actual summaries. 6. Month-end, MIS and audit assistance
 Maintain monthly closing checklists and pending-item trackers. Prepare AP/AR ageing, advances, expense and reconciliation summaries. Organise invoices, bank proofs, statements and audit schedules in approved folders. Skills and eligibility
 Basic accounting and debit/credit understanding; familiarity with GST and TDS concepts. Working knowledge of Excel (SUMIFS, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, PivotTables); Tally Prime or Zoho Books preferred. Accuracy, confidentiality, documentation discipline and proactive coordination. Expected deliverables
 Daily: invoice verification log and document-pending list. Weekly: vendor/customer reconciliation and discrepancy trackers. Monthly: draft GST reconciliation, bank reconciliation, outstanding advances and closing checklist. Access and approval controls
The intern may prepare entries, working papers and reports only within assigned permissions. Final posting, vendor master approval, payments, journal adjustments, tax treatment, statutory filing and financial sign-off must remain with authorised employees. All corrections require review and an audit trail.
Suggested performance indicators
Invoice checking coverage: 100% of assigned invoices | Data accuracy: target 98%+ | Reconciliation and closing trackers: completed by agreed deadlines | Document filing: 100% of assigned documents. Targets should be adjusted to transaction volumes and training stage.

title: Equity Research Analyst - Sell Side
description:
Position Title: Equity Fundamental Research Analyst BFSI Department: Institutional Equity Research (Sell Side) Reporting to: Head of Research / Senior Analyst – BFSI Experience: 4-9 years in Equity Research, covering the BFSI sector, preferably in a Sell-Side setup Location: Andheri (Chakala), Mumbai – Head Office Company Profile: LKP Securities Ltd. is a leading financial services provider in India. Established in 1948, the company has a rich history of offering a wide range of services including equity and commodity broking, financial planning, investment advisory, wealth management, and research. LKP Securities has a strong presence in major Indian cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Surat, Pune, Nashik. The company is known for its robust risk management practices and cutting-edge technology platforms that enable seamless trading and investment processes for its clients. With a team of experienced professionals, LKP Securities is committed to delivering quality services to individual and institutional investors. The company's research division provides in-depth analysis and market insights, allowing clients to make informed investment decisions. Role Overview: The Equity Fundamental Research Analyst – BFSI will be responsible for tracking, analyzing, and building fundamental research coverage on companies within the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) sector, as part of LKP's sell-side institutional research desk. The role involves building and maintaining detailed financial models, preparing sector and company-specific research reports, tracking quarterly results and regulatory developments, and supporting institutional sales and clients with actionable investment insights on BFSI stocks. The incumbent will work closely with the Head of Research, Institutional Sales, Dealing, and Compliance teams to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant research output on the BFSI universe.
 Key Responsibilities: Track and build fundamental research coverage on BFSI sector companies (banks, NBFCs, insurance, AMCs, and other financial services companies). Build and maintain detailed financial models (P&L, balance sheet, ratio analysis, valuation) for companies under coverage. Prepare initiating coverage reports, quarterly result updates, sector thematic notes, and event-based notes on BFSI stocks. Track quarterly results, management commentary, concalls, and investor presentations of companies under coverage and translate them into actionable research notes. Monitor RBI, IRDAI, SEBI, and other regulatory developments impacting the BFSI sector, and assess their impact on covered companies. Build and update earnings estimates, target prices, and investment ratings (Buy/Hold/Sell) based on fundamental analysis. Attend management meetings, industry conferences, and channel checks to build a differentiated view on BFSI companies. Support the institutional sales team and dealers with stock-specific and sector-specific inputs for client interactions. Participate in client calls, roadshows, and marketing of research ideas to institutional investors (FIIs/DIIs/domestic funds). Coordinate with Compliance to ensure all research reports adhere to SEBI Research Analyst regulations and internal review processes. Track peer companies, competitive positioning, and cross-sector read-throughs within BFSI to strengthen research quality. Maintain and update sector databases, valuation summary sheets, and comparative company matrices on a regular basis. Stay updated on macro-economic indicators (interest rates, credit growth, asset quality trends) relevant to the BFSI sector.
 Key Skills & Competencies: 
 
 Strong understanding of BFSI sector dynamics – banking, NBFC, insurance, and asset management business models. Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques (DCF, P/E, P/B, P/BV, embedded value for insurance, etc.). Strong analytical and quantitative skills with high attention to detail. Excellent report writing and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate a clear investment thesis. Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and financial databases (Bloomberg, Capital IQ, Ace Equity, or similar). Good understanding of SEBI Research Analyst regulations and sell-side research compliance requirements. Strong communication skills to interact with company managements, institutional clients, and internal sales teams. Ability to work under tight timelines, particularly during quarterly result seasons. Strong analytical and commercial acumen. Qualifications & Experience: Graduate / Postgraduate in Finance, Economics, Commerce, or related discipline. MBA Finance, CFA, or CA (completed or pursuing) will be preferred. 4-9 years of relevant experience in equity research, with specific coverage of the BFSI sector. Prior sell-side research experience preferred; buy-side or credit research experience with BFSI exposure will also be considered. NISM Research Analyst certification preferred (or willingness to acquire). Proven ability to independently track a sector, build financial models, and deliver research output within tight timelines.

Key Skills: Equity Research Analysis,Research,Institutional sales,SIDE,Equity analysis,Analysis,Fundamental research,Equity research

title: Key Account Manager - C&SP Segment
description:
Job Summary 
 Role Overview The Key Account Manager (KAM) is a senior technical sales leadership role responsible for managing and growing relationships with nominated Global Strategic Accounts across India. This position requires deep expertise in the Data Centre, Hyperscale, and Colocation segments, with the ability to influence key stakeholders-up to the C-Suite-within customer organizations, as well as ecosystem partners such as consultants, specifiers, and contractors. The KAM will drive Schneider Electric's complete portfolio across business units, acting as the opportunity leader for complex, multi-country pursuits and ensuring seamless collaboration between Secure Power and other divisions. This is a highly strategic role requiring business acumen, technical competency, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to execute global strategy at a country level. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Serve as the country owner for assigned global strategic accounts and translate global strategy into local execution. Build strong multi-level customer relationships including C-level, influencers, and operational teams. Develop, manage, and execute Strategic Account Plans across the region. Identify, shape, and drive opportunities for the One Schneider Electric portfolio, including Secure Power, Digital Energy, Industrial Automation, Power Systems, Power Products, and Services. Lead complex, large-scale pursuits as the opportunity leader, mobilizing virtual teams across countries and divisions. Develop and grow Data Centre-related business (hyperscale and colocation) across electrical, cooling, software, automation, and services offerings. Build strong working relationships with Country Leadership, Divisions, and Regional Teams to define and execute winning strategies. Engage with and influence the broader ecosystem of consultants, specifiers, and contractors involved in data centre construction and expansion. Ensure cross-functional alignment across Sales, Pre-Sales, Tendering, and Execution teams. Deliver on orders, revenue, margin, and ensure forecast accuracy. Maintain strong compliance with Customer Project Process (CPP) and uphold CRM discipline and data quality. Conduct feasibility analysis of bids, tenders, and contracting documents for all key opportunities. 
 
 Experience and Requirements 
 
 Commercial Technical Experience Requirements 
 Deep technical sales experience in Data Centre Solutions including power, cooling, electrical distribution, automation, and associated services. Proven capability to manage and grow large strategic/global accounts. Strong understanding of account management principles, sales channels, and partner ecosystems. Demonstrated capability to uncover and articulate customer pain points and propose high-value, integrated solutions. Experience selling within a matrix organization and managing multi-stakeholder environments. 
 
 Leadership Competencies 
 Ability to lead virtual, cross-functional, and remote teams across geographies. Strong capability to navigate complex matrix organizations in a multicultural environment. High initiative, strong ownership mindset, and excellent organizational skills. Ability to influence and align diverse internal and external stakeholders. 
 
 Communication Interpersonal Skills 
 Strong executive presence with the ability to engage at C-Level. Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear, compelling business language. High emotional intelligence, resilience, and collaborative mindset. 
 
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in engineering; MBA preferred. 10-15+ years of experience in Key Account Management or similar roles within the Data Centre ecosystem. Experience working with Hyperscalers, Global Cloud Providers, or Colocation Operators preferred. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Willingness to travel (domestic/international as required). Ability to collaborate and operate across multiple time zones.

title: Sr Manager, Fund Accounting
description:
Overview The Senior Manager is responsible for overseeing the delivery of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services across multiple client portfolios. The role provides leadership across NAV processing, investor reporting, capital calls, distributions, management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, and other fund operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality service delivery. Acting as a senior client contact, the Senior Manager manages relationships with clients, auditors, banks, custodians, brokers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and service level commitments. The role also drives process improvements, technology initiatives, risk management, and team development to support operational excellence and business growth. 
 Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities Strategic Focus Provide strategic leadership and oversight of private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client expectations, and operational priorities. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients, auditors, custodians, banks, brokers, and other strategic stakeholders, fostering long-term partnerships and service excellence. Drive operational excellence across NAV production, investor servicing, custody operations, financial reporting, and fund administration activities to ensure consistent, high-quality client outcomes. Oversee complex fund structures, transactions, and reporting requirements, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, capital calls, and distributions. Champion operational transformation through process optimization, technology enablement, automation, and scalable service delivery models. Provide strategic oversight of compliance with fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and internal control frameworks across client portfolios. Contribute to business growth, strategic initiatives, organizational development, and continuous enhancement of the operating model to support long-term success. Direct resource planning, capacity management, and organizational alignment to support efficient service delivery, business growth, and evolving client requirements. Lead and develop managers, team leaders, and fund accounting teams to drive high performance, service excellence, and achievement of operational and client delivery objectives. Serve as a senior relationship lead for key clients and strategic stakeholders across the broader client portfolio. Operational Management Provide oversight of end-to-end private equity fund accounting and fund administration services, ensuring the accurate, timely, and consistent delivery of client commitments across multiple portfolios. Oversee NAV production, investor allocations, capital calls, distributions, fund expense payments, custody activities, and related fund operations to ensure quality and operational effectiveness. Lead operational execution through effective resource planning, workload management, capacity optimization, and performance oversight across teams. Ensure the consistent achievement of service level agreements (SLAs), client deadlines, and quality standards across all client engagements. Review and approve key fund accounting deliverables, including management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, waterfall models, and other complex fund accounting outputs. Direct audit, financial statement, and regulatory reporting activities to ensure accuracy, compliance, and timely completion. Drive continuous improvement, standardization, and operational efficiency initiatives to enhance scalability, consistency, and service quality. Provide strategic oversight of operational enhancement initiatives to improve service delivery and operating effectiveness. Provide leadership and oversight for relationships with auditors, banks, custodians, brokers, administrators, and internal stakeholders to support seamless service delivery. Ensure adherence to fund governing documents, regulatory obligations, and internal control frameworks across all operational activities. Monitor operational performance, service quality, and client outcomes to ensure achievement of business and client objectives. Drive consistency, standardization, and best practices across teams and client portfolios. Oversee the resolution of client issues, operational challenges, and escalations, ensuring effective outcomes and a high standard of client service. Support business growth through scalable operating models, operational excellence, and strategic service delivery initiatives. People Leadership Lead, coach, and develop managers, team leaders, and fund accounting professionals, fostering a high-performance, client-focused culture and strong leadership capability across the function. Provide ongoing mentorship, guidance, and development opportunities to strengthen expertise in fund accounting, NAV production, private equity operations, and client service delivery. Drive performance management through objective setting, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career development planning to support individual and organizational success. Oversee workforce planning, resource allocation, and capacity management to optimize operational effectiveness and ensure successful delivery of client commitments. description:

You will run end-to-end reporting deliverables, strengthen controls, and drive lasting fixes to recurring issues. You will partner closely with operations, treasury, product, technology, and change teams to deliver accurate outcomes in a high-control, time-sensitive environment.

As a Associate in India Branch Regulatory Reporting & Treasury Markets Operations, you will own non-financial regulatory reporting delivery and related operations processes. You will interpret requirements, ensure data quality and reconciliations, manage exceptions through closure, and maintain audit-ready evidence. You will also drive process improvements, including automation and control enhancements, and support change delivery for regulatory and business initiatives. This role requires strong treasury product knowledge, sound judgement, and the ability to influence across teams. Job responsibilities Own end-to-end preparation, review, and submission of non-financial regulatory reports, including PDR, GPB, FTD, SFR, FSU, CRILC, reporting to Credit Information Companies, IBS, Return on Connected Exposure/Intra-group Exposure, and RBS, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. Interpret regulations and internal policies, documenting key judgements, assumptions, and reporting methodologies to support consistency and auditability. Lead data quality and reconciliation routines, including reasonability checks, variance analysis, break investigation, and exception resolution with upstream data owners. Drive ledger and system reconciliations, prioritising ageing items, coordinating ownership, and ensuring timely closure of breaks. Support funding and liquidity-related operational activities by resolving issues impacting settlements, positions, and reporting through effective cross-team coordination. Manage daily operational and reporting queries with clear ownership and escalation discipline, highlighting risks early and driving closure. Perform root-cause analysis on recurring issues and implement preventive actions to reduce repeat breaks and manual rework. Deliver process improvements across reporting and reconciliations, including automation opportunities, control enhancements, and standardisation of procedures. Support change delivery for regulatory updates, policy changes, product changes, process redesign, and system migrations, including impact assessment, testing, and go-live readiness. Maintain strong risk and control discipline through structured issue management, timely remediation, and audit readiness.
 Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills Bachelor s degree. Minimum 10 years of experience in treasury markets operations and/or non-financial regulatory reporting. Strong knowledge of treasury products, including government securities, corporate bonds, certificates of deposit, pass-through certificates, foreign exchange (cash, TOM, spot, forwards, cancellations, options), interest rate swaps, cross-currency interest rate swaps, forward rate agreements, repurchase agreements, and call money borrowing and lending. Demonstrated ability to lead reconciliations and investigations end-to-end, including prioritisation, stakeholder coordination, and closure of breaks and exceptions. Strong controls mindset with experience supporting audits, regulatory reviews, evidence standards, and remediation follow-through. Strong data orientation, with comfort using reporting, analytics, and automation tools such as Tableau, Alteryx, or UiPath. Proven ability to partner with product, technology, and change teams to deliver enhancements and manage change. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and seniority levels. Strong judgement under time pressure, with clear escalation decisions and disciplined execution.
 Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills Master of Business Administration, Chartered Accountant, or Chartered Financial Analyst qualification. Experience supporting fixed income, money markets, and over-the-counter foreign exchange and derivatives operations. Familiarity with trade lifecycle controls and operational control frameworks. Familiarity with cross-border payments, foreign exchange, and global custody concepts. Experience using intelligent automation tools to improve operational workflows.

title: Accounts And Finance Manager
description:
Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Accounting & Reporting Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accurate, complete and timely recording of financial transactions in accordance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Manage monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing, including general ledger scrutiny, balance sheet schedules, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and intercompany reconciliations. Prepare and review financial statements, management reports, MIS and variance analysis for senior management. Ensure timely closure of books and adherence to defined reporting timelines. Maintain robust accounting documentation, schedules, reconciliations and supporting records. Monitor accounting treatment for lending transactions, interest income, processing fees, partner commissions, operating expenses and other business transactions. 2. Treasury & Banking Operations Oversee bank reconciliations, cash and bank balances, fund flows and liquidity-related accounting. Coordinate with the Treasury team on borrowings, lender reconciliations, interest calculations, repayment schedules, loan balances and related accounting entries. Ensure accurate accounting and reconciliation of loan disbursements, customer collections, repayments, settlements and bank/payment gateway transactions. Monitor accounting of borrowing costs, accrued interest, processing charges and other financing expenses. Support preparation and review of borrowing-related statements, lender confirmations and treasury MIS. 3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Oversee timely preparation, review and filing of GST, TDS, income tax and other applicable statutory returns. Ensure accurate computation and accounting of tax provisions, deferred taxes, statutory liabilities and tax-related reconciliations, as applicable. Manage GST reconciliations, input tax credit reviews, vendor compliance and resolution of tax discrepancies. Monitor changes in applicable tax laws and ensure timely implementation of relevant compliance requirements. 4. RBI Reporting & Regulatory Compliance Coordinate preparation, validation and submission of applicable RBI returns and regulatory statements in consultation with the Compliance and Regulatory Reporting teams. Ensure consistency between regulatory submissions, accounting records, financial statements and underlying operational data. Support NBFC-specific reporting, audit requirements, regulatory inspections and information requests. Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence for regulatory reporting and compliance reviews. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to address reporting discrepancies and ensure timely remediation. 5. Audit, Internal Controls & Risk Management Lead coordination for statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, concurrent audits and other applicable reviews. Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and management responses within agreed timelines. Support due diligence, financial reviews and information requests from lenders, investors and other stakeholders. 8. Team Management & Stakeholder Coordination Lead, guide and review the work of the Finance & Accounts team, including task allocation, performance monitoring and capability development. Liaise with statutory auditors, tax consultants, banks, lenders and external service providers. Provide timely and reliable financial information to senior management for decision-making. Eligibility Criteria Education Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Experience Manager / Senior Manager: Typically 23 years of relevant post-qualification experience. Experience in an NBFC, fintech, digital lending company or BFSI organisation is preferred. Exposure to lending operations, treasury, financial reporting, regulatory compliance and audit management will be an advantage. Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial reporting, taxation and statutory compliance. Practical understanding of NBFC operations, digital lending, loan accounting and treasury processes. Experience in month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, MIS preparation and audit management. Familiarity with applicable RBI reporting requirements and NBFC regulatory frameworks. Proficiency in MS Excel, accounting software and ERP systems such as Oracle, SAP or Tally. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and process-management skills. Ability to lead a team, manage multiple priorities and deliver within tight deadlines. Effective communication and stakeholder-management capabilities. A process-oriented mindset with a focus on automation, accuracy, governance and continuous improvement. Key Success Measures Timely and accurate monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures. Accuracy and completeness of financial statements, MIS and regulatory submissions. Timely completion of statutory filings and resolution of tax and audit observations. Effective reconciliation and closure of outstanding accounting differences. Strengthening of internal financial controls and reduction in recurring control gaps. Improved efficiency through process automation and reduced manual intervention. Effective team management and adherence to agreed service levels and reporting timelines.

title: Sr. Manager, Accounting
description:
About the Role: Vercel is scaling fast, and the Senior Manager, Accounting will be a critical hire as we build out the financial infrastructure that supports our global growth and path to the public markets. You will own end-to-end accounting operations for Vercels statutory accounting across current and future entities, from monthly close and statutory compliance to audit support and process improvement. Working closely with the Head of Finance, India Center of Excellence, the US-based Controller and global finance team, youll bring rigor, ownership, and a builders mindset to a function that is growing quickly. This role is fully remote from your home office in India, with regular overlap hours with the US team. You will report to the Head of Finance, CoE who is also based in India. What You Will Do: Lead the full-cycle monthly and quarterly close for Vercels current and future international entities, setting clear standards for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness in accordance with both local and US GAAP. Guide and support accounts payable and accounts receivable teams for correct accounting, manage payroll accounting and intercompany transactions in coordination with the global finance team. Own statutory compliance including preparation and supporting filing of FS, auditsTDS/TCS returns,, and coordination with external auditors and tax advisors. Also coordinate with the corporate secretaries for various secretarial compliance. Partner with the US-based Controller and CAO on the global close; prepare and review journal entries, account reconciliations, and financial statements. Partner with SOX leader helping with Design, implement, and evolve SOX-aligned controls and internal accounting policies for the international entities as the business scales amd execute these controls consistently Lead close process improvements and accelerate the closing process; identify automation and AI opportunities, simplify workflows, and build scalable infrastructure for the finance function. Own the audit relationship for these international entities; preparing materials, answering auditor questions, and keeping audits running smoothly. Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, HR, FP&A, and Revenue Operations on new business initiatives with accounting implications. Mentor and develop junior accounting staff as the CoE team grows. Support the US GAAP Accounting for the US based entity(s) as and when required in different areas. Help the organization in pre and post merger and acquisition activities such as due diligence, integrating the acquired entities, supporting compliance, data migration, etc. Lead the new entities setup in different countries representing the accounting team and having these entities operational. Monitor changes in local GAAP, tax, regulatory, and corporate compliance requirements for international entities and ensure timely implementation in accounting processes. Support cash, banking, treasury accounting, and foreign exchange accounting matters for international entities, including bank reconciliations, revaluations, realized/unrealized FX, and cash reporting. About You: 12+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years in managing a team. CA (Chartered Accountant) designation required; CPA or equivalent international qualification is a plus. Deep expertise in technical accounting, including IFRS and US GAAP, with the ability to research, interpret, and apply local GAAP, statutory accounting requirements, tax regulations, and regulatory reporting obligations across multiple jurisdictions. Hands-on experience with ERP systems; NetSuite strongly preferred. Proven track record managing or supporting Big 4 / top-tier audits. Experience at a high-growth technology or SaaS company; must have prior exposure to multi-entity, international accounting structures. Process-minded and curious, with experience leveraging AI, automation, and systems to improve accuracy and efficiency. Clear, confident communicator who collaborates effectively across remote, cross-functional, and cross-cultural teams. Self-starter who thrives in an async-first environment with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Comfortable working in a builder environment where processes may be evolving, documentation may need to be created from scratch, and the role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they dont necessarily check every box on the job description.
