title: B2B Collection Executive
description:
Position Overview The Collection Executive plays a critical role in managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely payments, and maintaining strong commercial relationships with corporate and enterprise clients. Operating within the B2B pest management sector, this role bridges finance and customer service, requiring a balance of persistence, professionalism, and industry-specific awareness of service-level agreements (SLAs). Key Responsibilities * Accounts Receivable Management: Monitor client accounts to identify overdue invoices and outstanding balances across a diverse B2B portfolio (commercial, industrial, hospitality, and corporate clients). * Payment Follow-ups & Reminders: Proactively communicate with client accounts payable departments via phone, email, and virtual meetings to secure timely payments in accordance with agreed credit terms. * Dispute & Query Resolution: Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, service delivery disputes, or missing documentation (such as service completion reports, digitally signed job cards, or vendor portal entry issues) in coordination with operations and service teams. * Aging Report Analysis: Regularly review and report on the Accounts Receivable (AR) aging bucket, providing management with accurate cash flow projections and risk assessments for delayed payments. * Receipt Reconciliation & Documentation: Accurately post and reconcile incoming payments against respective invoices, maintaining up-to-date ledger records and issuing official receipts or statements of account. * Credit Control Support: Assist in evaluating the creditworthiness of new B2B clients and help enforce company credit policies to minimize bad debt. Required Qualifications & Skills * Education: Bachelors degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. * Experience: 2 to 4 years of proven experience in B2B debt recovery, accounts receivable, or corporate collections—preferably within the service industry, facility management, or allied B2B sectors. * Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with strong negotiation abilities to resolve payment bottlenecks while preserving client relationships. * Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Zoho, or Tally) and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables, aging schedules). * Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with service-based billing cycles, digital invoicing portals, and vendor payment approval workflows commonly used by corporate clients. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Days Sales Outstanding (DSO): Reduction and maintenance of average collection periods. * Collection Efficiency Ratio (CER): Percentage of total receivables collected within the targeted billing cycle. * Aging Portfolio Management: Minimization of overdue balances sitting in the 60+ and 90+ day aging buckets. * Dispute Resolution Time: Speed and accuracy in resolving billing queries to unblock pending payments.

Key Skills: B2B Collection,Book Keeping,Collections,Collection Management,Payment Collection,Accounts Receivable,Credit Collection,Credit Control

title: Finance Head
description:
Head Finance & Accounts Goodman Vetcare Pvt. Ltd. is a growing animal healthcare business operating across pet retail and e-commerce through Animeal , veterinary medicines, veterinary medical instruments and equipment, and B2B animal healthcare. As the business continues to grow and prepares for future fundraising, we are looking for an experienced Head – Finance & Accounts who can take ownership of the finance and accounting function and build strong financial controls across the organisation. The role will work closely with the Founder/Directors and manage the existing accounts team. Key Responsibilities Take overall responsibility for accounts, finance, taxation and statutory compliance . Supervise day-to-day accounting, reconciliations and month-end/year-end closure. Manage GST, TDS, income tax and other statutory compliances , including timely filings and reconciliations. Coordinate with statutory auditors, tax consultants, banks and other external professionals. Lead preparation for statutory audits, tax audits and internal audits . Prepare accurate monthly MIS, P&L, Balance Sheet, cash-flow reports and management dashboards . Develop and monitor annual budgets, forecasts and department-wise expenditure . Track receivables, payables, working capital and cash-flow requirements. Maintain daily visibility of bank balances, collections, payments and major financial commitments . Strengthen internal controls, approval processes and financial discipline across the organisation. Review vendor/customer reconciliations and resolve accounting discrepancies. Support management in pricing, margins, profitability and business decision-making. Ensure books and documentation are maintained in a manner suitable for investor and lender due diligence . Assist in preparation of financial information, schedules, reports and documentation required during fundraising, due diligence and investor discussions . Coordinate across multiple businesses/entities and provide consolidated financial information to the Directors. Lead, train and review the existing accounts team. Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is hands-on, commercially aware and strong on compliance , rather than someone who only supervises accounting from a distance. The ideal candidate should have: 7–12 years of relevant Finance & Accounts experience. Strong practical knowledge of GST, TDS, taxation, audits and statutory compliance . Experience preparing and reviewing P&L, Balance Sheet, cash-flow statements and MIS . Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and working-capital management . Excellent Excel skills and experience with accounting/ERP systems. Experience dealing directly with auditors, consultants, banks and government authorities. Ability to manage multiple companies/entities and supervise an accounts team. Strong attention to detail, ownership and ability to work independently. Experience in a growing company, startup, retail, e-commerce, healthcare, pharma or distribution environment would be useful. Qualification: CA / CMA preferred. Strong CA Inter, M.Com or MBA-Finance candidates with substantial hands-on experience may also be considered. What success in this role should look like The Directors should be able to get, at any time, a clear picture of: Cash available 
 Sales and collections 
 Receivables and payables 
 Profitability 
 Upcoming liabilities 
 Tax/compliance status 
 Budget vs actual 
 Financial risks requiring management attention And your books should be sufficiently organised that when an investor asks for financial information or begins due diligence, you are preparing documents—not repairing accounting records .

title: Senior Manager / Director / AVP - Accounts Receivable
description:
About the Role : 
 We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven Senior Manager / Director / AVP Accounts Receivable to lead end to-end AR operations for our US healthcare clients. This is a senior individual contributor and people management role requiring deep expertise in the US healthcare revenue cycle, strong analytical capabilities, and the ability to drive collections efficiency across multiple client portfolios. The incumbent will work out of our India office on the US shift, collaborating closely with onshore client stakeholders and cross-functional teams. 
 Key Responsibilities : 
 AR Operations & Collections Management Oversee end-to-end AR follow-up for assigned client accounts across multiple payers including Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and Managed Care. Monitor and manage key AR metrics ,AR Days, Collection Rate, First Pass Resolution Rate, Denial Rate, and Ageing Bucket distribution. Drive timely resolution of outstanding claims, ensuring collections targets and SLA benchmarks are met consistently. Implement and oversee denial management workflows, root cause analysis, and corrective action plans. Manage work queues, prioritise high-value/ageing claims, and ensure zero revenue leakage. Team Leadership & Performance Management Lead, mentor, and manage a team of AR Analysts, Team Leads, and Associates (team size: 50-100 FTE's). Define daily/weekly targets, conduct performance reviews, and implement productivity improvement plans. Identify training gaps and coordinate with the L&D team for skill enhancement and cross-training programs. Foster a high-performance, accountability-driven team culture aligned with client expectations. Client Engagement & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary point of escalation for AR-related client queries and issues. Participate in weekly/monthly client review calls, presenting performance dashboards, trend analysis, and action plans. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with US-based client stakeholders and onshore counterparts. Manage client escalations professionally, ensuring prompt resolution and communication. Process Improvement & Compliance Identify process gaps and drive initiatives to optimise AR workflows, reduce denial rates, and accelerate cash flow. Ensure adherence to HIPAA regulations, client-specific compliance policies, and internal quality standards. Collaborate with IT and technology teams on system enhancements, automation, and reporting improvements. Develop and document SOPs, process guides, and best practices for the AR function. Reporting & Analytics Prepare and present comprehensive AR performance reports daily, weekly, and monthly to senior leadership. Analyse payer behaviour, reimbursement trends, and denial patterns to drive strategic decision-making. Maintain dashboards and data integrity across practice management and billing systems. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field. 10-15 years of progressive experience in US Healthcare AR / Revenue Cycle Management in a BPO / KPO setup. Minimum 3-5 years in a managerial or senior leadership role managing large AR teams. In-depth knowledge of the US healthcare billing lifecycle charge entry, claim submission, denial management, payment posting, and collections. Strong working knowledge of payer-specific rules across Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and Managed Care plans. Proficiency in practice management / billing systems such as CMD, AMD, eCW or similar platforms. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, dashboards) and reporting tools. Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding AR and collections targets in a high-volume BPO environment. Willingness and ability to work full-time from the office on the US shift (night shift, EST/CST hours). Communication & Interpersonal Skills Exceptional verbal and written English communication skills mandatory for daily interaction with US based clients and stakeholders. Ability to present complex data and operational insights clearly and confidently to senior leadership and client teams. Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills for managing payer disputes and client escalations. Effective cross-functional communicator with the ability to collaborate seamlessly across operations, quality, IT, and HR teams. Executive presence with professional email etiquette and formal business communication skills. Preferred / Good to Have Certification in Healthcare Revenue Cycle (CRCR, CHFP, or equivalent) is highly desirable. Experience with automation tools for AR workflows is a strong advantage. Exposure to multi-speciality or hospital billing environments. Six Sigma / Lean process improvement certification. Prior experience handling transition or on boarding of new AR client accounts. Work Mode Work from Office 5 days a week (mandatory). No hybrid/remote option. Candidates must be comfortable working night shifts from the office on a permanent basis. Flexibility to extend hours during month-end, quarter-end, or client escalation periods is expected. 
 Shift Timing US Night Shift aligned to EST/CST (approx. 6:30 PM 3:30 AM IST or as per client requirement).

The role is suited for professionals who enjoy problem-solving, financial analysis, MIS, financial reporting and working on different assignments for different clients , rather than performing repetitive month-on-month finance activities for a single organization. Our team works with clients on robust MIS, financial statements, financial reporting, audit coordination and various special financial/consulting assignments. 
 Key Responsibilities Preparation and review of robust and management-oriented MIS reports . Preparation/review of financial statements and financial reporting. Analysis of financial performance, profitability, working capital and key business metrics. Supporting clients in improving financial reporting and management information systems. Coordination with statutory auditors and assisting clients in getting audits completed. Understanding client businesses and translating financial information into meaningful management insights. Preparation of various financial databases, schedules, reports and special-purpose documents. Working on special assignments/projects for multiple clients. Supporting senior team members in client meetings and presentations. Handling multiple clients/assignments and managing timelines simultaneously. Identifying inconsistencies, gaps and unusual trends in financial information. Developing an understanding of different business models and industries through client exposure.

This role is particularly suitable for candidates who have experience in a corporate finance/accounts role and feel that repetitive monthly/quarterly reporting for one company limits their learning. The VCFO environment provides exposure to multiple companies, industries, business models and assignments within the same year , allowing candidates to continuously learn and solve new financial and business problems.

title: Actuarial Associate Manager
description:
The Role The Actuarial Associate Manager is responsibility to manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial projects across reserving, pricing, capital, risk modelling and financial reporting. The role combines hands-on actuarial expertise with technical review, project management, client engagement and day-to-day guidance of a small team or project workstream. You will apply sound actuarial judgement to data, methods, assumptions, models and conclusions; ensure high-quality and timely delivery; explain findings clearly to clients and senior colleagues; and build team capability through coaching, feedback and knowledge sharing. What You Will Do Actuarial Project Delivery Manage the end-to-end delivery of actuarial assignments across P&C reserving, pricing and insurance optimisation, captive capital and Solvency II, risk financing, and financial reporting. Define and manage scope, workplans, timelines, budgets, dependencies and quality checkpoints for small to medium projects or workstreams within larger engagements. Prepare and oversee forward-looking loss forecasts, reserve analyses, capital assessments and other bespoke actuarial models for corporate and captive insurance clients. Interpret model outputs, investigate movements and translate technical results into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Technical Review and Quality Assurance Perform independent technical and editorial review of data, methodologies, assumptions, calculations, models and client deliverables, applying reasonableness checks and actuarial judgement. Ensure work is accurate, reproducible, appropriately documented and compliant with applicable professional, regulatory and internal standards. Resolve routine and moderately complex technical issues using established methods and prior experience, escalating novel or higher-risk matters when appropriate. Maintain clear review evidence and support continuous improvement of templates, controls and quality frameworks. Lead or contribute substantively to client calls, meetings, workshops and presentations, explaining actuarial methods, findings, limitations and recommendations in accessible language. Work collaboratively with colleagues across geographies and disciplines, coordinating inputs and ensuring effective information exchange. Team Leadership and Capability Building Coordinate the daily activities of analysts and senior analysts on assigned engagements, allocate work and monitor progress against agreed plans. Coach colleagues, answer technical queries and provide timely, constructive feedback that improves actuarial judgement, communication and delivery quality. Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions and contribute to a cooperative, inclusive environment that encourages technical development and shared learning. Support resource planning, workload prioritisation, onboarding and development discussions for the immediate team. Core Areas of Work Area / Typical responsibilities P&C Pricing and Optimisation - Loss forecasting, insurance programme analysis, risk transfer optimisation and strategic recommendations. P&C Reserving - Reserving analysis, movement investigation, methods and assumptions, report writing and clear presentation of conclusions. Capital and Solvency II - Profitability and financial strength assessment for captives, review of SCR and technical provisions, assumption challenge and regulatory support. Bespoke Analytics -Risk financing, modelling tools, scenario analysis, automation, research and multidisciplinary risk projects. Experience and Qualifications Recognised degree in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, economics, engineering or another highly numerate discipline. A minimum of 8 out of 13 actuarial examinations completed toward a recognised actuarial qualification. At least 5 years of relevant actuarial experience, including experience in one or more of P&C reserving, pricing, capital, risk financing, captive insurance or financial reporting. Experience managing project delivery or workstreams, reviewing actuarial work and guiding junior colleagues. Advanced written and spoken English, with the ability to produce concise reports and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Technical Tools Strong Microsoft Office capability is required. Proficiency in at least one relevant analytical or actuarial tool is expected, such as R/R Shiny, Python, Power BI, RADAR, Igloo or ResQ. The successful candidate should be able to select fit-for-purpose tools, review outputs critically and support reproducible analysis. This description outlines the principal responsibilities of the role. Responsibilities may evolve in line with business needs, client demand and the development of the successful candidate.

Key Skills: Actuarial,Capability Building,Power BI,Technical Review,Project Delivery,Team Leadership,P&C reserving,Quality Assurance

description:
Job Title : Business Finance Executive 
 Job Summary 
We are seeking a commercially driven finance professional who can transform financial and operational data into meaningful business insights. This role is focused on management reporting, business analytics, profitability analysis, budgeting support, and performance monitoring rather than routine accounting or taxation.
The ideal candidate should be highly proficient in Excel, comfortable working with large datasets, and capable of preparing insightful MIS reports that enable management to make informed business decisions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Management Information System (MIS) Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for management. Develop dashboards to monitor key business and financial metrics. Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency and accuracy. Ensure timely dissemination of business performance reports. 
 Business Analytics Analyse sales trends across products, brands, territories, channels, and customer segments. Identify opportunities for improving revenue, margins, and operational efficiency. Perform profitability analysis at product, customer, channel, and business-unit levels. Track KPIs and highlight key business exceptions and trends. 
 Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Assist in annual budgeting and periodic forecasting. Conduct budget vs. actual variance analysis with detailed commentary. Monitor departmental spending against approved budgets. Prepare financial models to support strategic decision-making. 
 Commercial Finance Analyse pricing, discounts, promotional schemes, and contribution margins. Evaluate the financial impact of new business initiatives. Support management with investment and cost-benefit analysis. Prepare business cases for new projects. 
 Data & Process Improvement Build Excel-based analytical models and dashboards. Work closely with ERP, Sales, Operations, and Accounts teams to ensure data accuracy. Recommend automation opportunities to reduce manual reporting. Standardize reporting formats across the organization. 
 Cross-functional Coordination Liaise with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Accounts teams. Translate business requirements into actionable financial insights. Present analytical findings to senior management. 
 Candidate Profile: 
 Education B.Com / BBA / MBA (Finance) CA Inter / CMA Inter preferred but not mandatory. Experience 3 to 6 years in Business Finance, FP&A, MIS, Commercial Finance, or Financial Analysis. Experience in B2C, Retail, E-commerce, Healthcare, Pharma, FMCG, or Consumer Goods businesses preferred. 
 Technical Skills: Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, Power Query, Power Pivot). Strong analytical and financial modelling skills. Experience with ERP systems. Power BI or Tableau experience would be a significant advantage. SQL knowledge is an added benefit. 
 Key Competencies: Strong analytical mindset. Commercial understanding of business operations. Ability to interpret numbers and explain business implications. Excellent presentation and communication skills. High attention to detail. Problem-solving and critical thinking. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 
 Key Deliverables: Daily Sales MIS Gross Margin & Contribution Analysis Product-wise Profitability Report Customer-wise Profitability Report Budget vs Actual Analysis Sales Trend Analysis Working Capital Dashboard Inventory Ageing & Slow-moving Stock Analysis Branch/Region Performance Dashboard Cash Flow MIS Executive Dashboard for Leadership Monthly Business Review (MBR) presentations 
 Success Metrics (KPIs): Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports. Actionable insights generated for business improvement. Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation. Quality of budget and forecast analysis. Improvement in reporting turnaround time. Effectiveness of dashboards and management presentations. 
 Ideal Candidate 
Someone who doesn't just report numbers but asks why the numbers changed . Should be curious, commercially aware, and able to convert raw data into recommendations that improve profitability, optimize costs, and support strategic decisions. The role serves as a finance business partner to leadership, enabling faster and better-informed decisions.

title: Finance Accounts Executive
description:
Dear Sir, 
 We are Looking for Finance & Accounts Executive 
 1. Accounting & Financial Reporting Responsible for day-to-day accounting and maintenance of books of accounts. Record and review purchase, sales, receipt, payment and journal entries. Maintain general ledger, vendor ledger and customer ledger. Ensure accurate and timely accounting in Far vision / ERP. Responsible for monthly preparation of financial statements and management financial reports, including Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement and other MIS reports. Prepare monthly management reports with comparison against the previous period, budget and/or previous year. Perform monthly ledger scrutiny, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses and other closing adjustments. 2. Investment Management Assist in managing the companys investment portfolio, including mutual funds, fixed-income instruments and other approved investments. Maintain investment records, maturity schedules and transaction statements. Process investment purchases, redemptions, switches and other investment transactions. Monitor investment income, interest, dividend and capital gains. Reconcile investment statements with books of accounts. Prepare investment portfolio and valuation reports for management. Coordinate with banks, mutual fund houses, brokers, wealth managers and other investment institutions. Ensure proper accounting and documentation of all investment transactions. 3. Treasury & Cash Management Monitor daily cash and bank positions and prepare cash-flow requirements. Assist in short-term and medium-term cash-flow planning. Ensure availability of funds for operational and investment requirements. Manage fund transfers between bank accounts based on business requirements. Monitor utilisation of surplus funds and deployment of excess liquidity. Prepare regular treasury reports and cash-flow forecasts for management. Monitor interest income, bank charges and other treasury-related transactions. 4. Banking Activities Handle day-to-day banking activities and coordinate with banks. Prepare and process fund transfers, payments and other banking instructions. Maintain bank account records and authorised signatory documentation. Prepare and review Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS). Coordinate with banks for account-related matters, confirmations, statements and documentation. Monitor bank balances, deposits, interest receipts and other banking transactions. Assist in opening/closing bank accounts and other banking formalities as required. 5. Month-End & Year-End Closing Responsible for timely completion of monthly accounting closure. Pass necessary provisions, accruals, depreciation and adjustment entries. Reconcile major balance sheet accounts. Ensure completeness and accuracy of monthly financial data. Coordinate with auditors during statutory, tax and internal audits. 6. MIS & Management Reporting Prepare monthly financial performance reports for management. Prepare business/division-wise and account-head-wise MIS. Analyse revenue, expenses, operating profit, PBT and cash flow. Prepare variance analysis against budget/previous year. Provide financial information and analysis to management for decision-making. Key Skills Required Strong knowledge of accounting and financial reporting. Good understanding of treasury, investments and banking operations. Knowledge of GST, TDS and basic statutory compliance. Strong MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP and financial formulas. Experience in SAP/ERP/Microsoft Business Central preferred. Good analytical and reconciliation skills. Ability to prepare and present monthly financials and MIS to management. Strong coordination skills with banks, auditors, investment institutions and internal departments. High level of accuracy, confidentiality and attention to detail. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Timely and accurate monthly financial statements and management reports. Timely completion of monthly and annual closing. Accuracy of cash-flow and treasury forecasts. Proper monitoring and reconciliation of investment portfolio. Timely execution and reconciliation of banking transactions. Timely vendor/customer and bank reconciliations. Accuracy and timeliness of GST/TDS compliance. Proper documentation and audit readiness. Effective utilisation of surplus funds and treasury management. Timely submission of MIS and financial analysis to management

description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Finance Clerical Associate to support the RTR - General accounting function. The role involves managing general accounting related documentation, performing Balance Sheet reconciliations, and assisting with making accounting entries and data analysis to ensure compliance and accuracy in financial processes. Please note this is not a taxation-related role but is a function managing a process within record-to-report (RTR) Key Responsibilities: - Maintain and update General Ledger (GL) records in accounting systems and spreadsheets, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data. - Perform monthly GL and balance sheet reconciliations, including ledger-to-subledger reviews, and investigate and resolve outstanding reconciling items. - Process and review accruals, prepayments, amortization, provisions, and statistical journals in accordance with company accounting policies. - Conduct GL trend analysis and account monitoring, identify unusual transactions, and prepare corrective journal entries where required. - Execute month-end close activities within defined timelines, ensuring accurate financial reporting and checklist adherence. - Perform FX revaluation, VAT netting, and tax-related accounting activities, ensuring accurate recording of tax and duty transactions. - Collaborate with business stakeholders and internal teams to resolve aged items, reconciliation exceptions, accounting queries, and discrepancies. - Support statutory and tax audits by preparing schedules, reconciliations, reports, and providing required documentation to auditors. - Generate and review financial reports, including revenue reports from source systems, aging analyses, and variance reporting to ensure data integrity and compliance.

Good understanding of invoices, receipts, credit notes, debit notes, and TDS. Strong communication, follow-up, and coordination skills. Good analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to handle multiple customer accounts and meet collection timelines. Preferred Candidate Profile

title: Financial Controller
description:
Key Stakeholders: CMD, Finance Leadership, AR, AP, Tax & Compliance, Treasury/Funding, FP&A, Operations, Procurement, Projects and External Auditors 
 Role Purpose The Finance Controller Closing & Reporting will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete and timely financial closure and reporting across Redbrick Offices pan-India operations. The role will own the monthly, quarterly and annual book-closing process, maintain the integrity of the General Ledger and Balance Sheet, ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, and provide reliable financial statements and management reports to senior leadership. The incumbent will work closely with AR, AP, Taxation, Treasury, FP&A and business teams to ensure that all financial information is accurately captured, reconciled and reported within defined timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Financial Closing & General Ledger Own the monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing process across entities, centres and cost centres. Establish and manage a detailed month-end closure calendar with clear ownership and timelines. Target completion of monthly financial closure within T+5 to T+7 working days. Review the General Ledger and ensure completeness and accuracy of accounting entries. Review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, depreciation, revenue recognition and other closing adjustments. Ensure all material income and expenses are accounted for in the appropriate reporting period. Review unusual, exceptional and manual journal entries before closure. Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures for revenue, expenses, purchases and liabilities. Identify and resolve long-outstanding or incorrectly classified GL balances. Maintain appropriate maker-checker controls throughout the closure process. 2. Financial Statements & Reporting Ensure timely and accurate preparation of: Profit & Loss Account Balance Sheet Cash Flow Statement Trial Balance Supporting schedules and reconciliations Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual financial reporting packs for senior management. Ensure consistency between books of accounts, financial statements, MIS and other management reports. Review Month-on-Month, Quarter-on-Quarter and Year-on-Year movements and investigate material variations. Provide clear explanations for significant accounting and financial movements. Support management reporting on revenue, EBITDA, operating costs, working capital and other key financial indicators. Ensure financial information presented to management is complete, accurate and supported by underlying records. 3. Balance Sheet Reconciliation & Control Own and review the monthly Balance Sheet reconciliation process. Ensure reconciliation of: Banks Accounts Receivable Accounts Payable Client and landlord security deposits Vendor advances Employee advances Inter-company/inter-unit accounts Fixed assets Statutory liabilities Accruals and provisions Other control and suspense accounts Ensure 100% monthly reconciliation of material Balance Sheet accounts. Investigate ageing and long-outstanding balances and drive closure with responsible teams. Ensure no unsupported or unexplained balances are carried forward without appropriate review and approval. 4. Revenue & Expense Accounting Review revenue recognition for licence fees/rent, managed-service charges, utilities, parking, ancillary services and other operating revenue relevant to the managed-office business. Ensure appropriate accounting of billed, unbilled, accrued and deferred revenue. Review major expense accruals and provisions to ensure completeness of liabilities. Ensure correct accounting treatment of security deposits, rent, CAM, utilities, fit-out/project expenditure and centre operating expenses. Review significant credit notes, write-offs, waivers and accounting adjustments from a financial-reporting perspective. Coordinate with AR and AP teams to ensure sub-ledgers are fully reconciled with the General Ledger before closure. 5. Fixed Assets & Capitalisation Review the Fixed Asset Register and ensure reconciliation with the General Ledger. Ensure correct accounting for asset additions, capitalisation, transfers, depreciation, impairment, disposal and retirement. Review accounting and capitalisation of new-centre fit-out and refurbishment expenditure. Ensure appropriate classification between capital expenditure and operating expenditure. Coordinate with Projects, Procurement and AP for timely financial closure and capitalisation of completed projects. 6. Accounting Standards & Policies Ensure financial reporting complies with applicable Ind AS, Companies Act requirements and company accounting policies. Ensure consistent application of accounting policies across entities and operating centres. Review accounting treatment for complex or non-routine transactions. Prepare and maintain accounting position papers and supporting documentation wherever required. Keep the organisation updated on relevant changes in accounting standards and their financial impact. 7. Audit & Statutory Reporting Act as a key finance coordinator for statutory audit, internal audit and other financial reviews. Prepare financial statements, schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents required by auditors. Ensure audit queries are responded to accurately and within agreed timelines. Coordinate with AR, AP, Tax, Treasury and other finance teams for audit requirements. Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of accounting and reporting-related observations. Minimise post-closure and post-audit adjustments through stronger monthly review processes. 8. Internal Financial Controls Strengthen financial controls relating to book closure, GL accounting, journal entries, reconciliations and financial reporting. Ensure material transactions are appropriately supported, authorised and recorded. Identify accounting/control gaps and recommend corrective actions. Conduct periodic GL scrutiny and exception-based reviews. Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails supporting financial transactions. Ensure adherence to approved finance SOPs, accounting policies and delegated authority matrices. 9. ERP, Automation & Process Improvement Drive standardisation of closing and reporting processes across centres and entities. Improve ERP-based accounting and reduce dependence on manual workings. Automate repetitive reconciliations, schedules and financial reports wherever feasible. Improve the accuracy and turnaround time of financial information. Strengthen controls over chart of accounts, cost centres and accounting masters. Support ERP/system enhancements impacting accounting, closure and reporting. 10. Team & Cross-Functional Coordination Lead and develop the Closing, GL & Reporting team. Define clear KRAs, closing responsibilities and review mechanisms. Work closely with AR, AP, Tax & Compliance, Treasury/Funding and FP&A teams to ensure timely availability of closure inputs. Coordinate with Operations, Procurement, Projects and other business functions for accounting and reconciliation matters. Drive accountability for delays or incomplete information impacting financial closure. Build a culture of accuracy, timeliness, ownership and financial discipline. 
 Key Deliverables / KPIs KPI 
 Expected Outcome Monthly Book Closure 
 T+5 to T+7 working days Balance Sheet Reconciliation 
 100% of material accounts every month Financial Reporting 
 Accurate and within agreed timelines GL Quality 
 Minimum unreconciled/unsupported balances Post-Closure Adjustments 
 Minimal Audit Completion 
 Within agreed timelines Audit Observations 
 Timely closure; no repeat observations Inter-company Reconciliation 
 100% monthly Financial Statements 
 Accurate and compliant with applicable Ind AS Process Improvement 
 Progressive automation and faster closure Candidate Profile Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory. Approximately 10–15 years of relevant post-qualification experience. Strong hands-on experience in financial controllership, General Ledger, book closure, consolidation and financial reporting. Experience working in an organisation with approximately 500–1,000+ Cr turnover or comparable scale/complexity preferred. Experience handling multi-location, multi-entity or multi-cost-centre operations. Strong knowledge of Ind AS, Companies Act requirements, financial statements, revenue recognition and internal financial controls. Strong experience in Balance Sheet reviews and reconciliations. Demonstrated experience managing monthly/quarterly/year-end closing under stringent timelines. Experience leading statutory audits and working directly with external auditors. Advanced knowledge of ERP/accounting systems and MS Excel; exposure to BI/reporting tools would be advantageous. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with an ability to identify accounting inconsistencies and control gaps. Strong stakeholder-management skills and ability to coordinate across multiple finance and business functions. Preferred Industry Background Candidates from Managed Offices / Co-working, Commercial Real Estate, Hospitality, Facilities Management, Retail, Infrastructure or other multi-location/high-transaction service businesses will be preferred. This aligns with the broader industry profile specified in the existing Financial Controller JD. Preferred Leadership Attributes Strong hands-on controllership mindset rather than only supervisory experience. Detail-oriented with strong command over financial numbers. Able to challenge incomplete or unsupported accounting entries. Strong ownership of deadlines and closure quality. Proactive in identifying financial and control issues before reporting deadlines. Capable of working effectively in a fast-growing, multi-location environment. Comfortable escalating material accounting issues and financial risks to senior management. High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional judgement. Please note - Job location will be at Kalina.

title: Assistant Manager - Finance
description:
Assistant Manager Finance 
 The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance. As Indias first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale. We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build whats next. If youre driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, youll feel right at home here. 
 About the Role This is a high-impact role within the finance function of one of India’s fastest-scaling fintech and crypto platforms. You will play a key role in driving revenue assurance for the core business, building meaningful MIS and reporting frameworks, managing entity-level accounting and reporting, and leading automation initiatives across finance operations. The role offers hands-on exposure to VDA accounting across multiple entities and the opportunity to solve complex finance challenges across crypto, treasury, banking, and global operations while building scalable processes and controls for the future of digital finance. 
 What You’ll Do Manage financial accounting, reporting, and support consolidation activities for multiple global entities while ensuring timely and accurate closures.  Own monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes including preparation and review of financial statements, schedules, and disclosures.  Drive MIS-to-financial statement reconciliations to ensure accuracy and consistency across group reporting.  Support revenue assurance for the core business by validating revenue reporting, reconciliations, and maintaining proper audit-ready documentation.  Work closely with auditors, tax consultants, and regulators to ensure compliance with IGAAP/Ind AS, IFRS, Companies Act, and other applicable requirements.  Improve finance processes, internal controls, and reporting frameworks to build scalable and efficient operations.  Lead finance automation and ERP enhancement initiatives, including Oracle NetSuite optimization and reporting improvements.  Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Tax, and Operations on business and regulatory initiatives.  Assist in preparing quarterly employee engagement and spend reports for business unit heads to provide visibility into budget utilization. 
 You’ll Excel in This Role If You Think like an owner and operate with high accountability in fast-moving environments.  Thrive in ambiguity and can bring structure to complex operational and accounting challenges.  Have strong technical depth across financial reporting, audits, and compliance frameworks.  Bring exceptional attention to detail while balancing speed, accuracy, and execution.  Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across business, finance, and technology teams.  Continuously look for opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve systems and workflows.  Are comfortable working in high-growth environments where priorities evolve rapidly. 
 You’ll Know You’re Winning When Financial close processes are running smoothly with timely and accurate reporting across entities.  MIS and financial statement reconciliations are consistent, reliable, and provide clear visibility to leadership.  Revenue assurance processes are strengthened with minimal reconciliation gaps and audit-ready documentation always available.  Audit cycles are completed efficiently with reduced observations and stronger compliance readiness.  Finance processes and reporting workflows are becoming more automated, scalable, and operationally efficient.  Cross-functional stakeholders rely on you for accurate reporting, timely insights, and dependable execution.  ERP and reporting enhancements are improving data accuracy, turnaround time, and overall finance productivity. 
 Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You This is an opportunity to be part of the finance function at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech and crypto platforms. You’ll work on high-impact areas such as VDA accounting, revenue assurance, global reporting, and finance automation while partnering closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. It’s a chance to solve complex finance challenges at scale and contribute to building the future of digital finance. 
 Hiring Process Here’s what your journey with us looks like: Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving Assignment / Simulation Round – (If Required) A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios (If Required) Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit 
 Where We Work We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space. With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our Mumbai office , where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time. 
 Perks That Empower You We believe great people deserve great experiences. Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities 
 Ready to Build What’s Next? If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it. Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

description:
About Leaping Frog Solutions 
 Leaping Frog Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (LFSPL) is an IT and ERP consulting company specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and ERP solutions . The company works with clients on ERP implementation, consulting and technology solutions. 
 We are looking for a skilled Senior Account Executive to join our Accounts & Finance team and manage accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, reporting and financial operations in a growing IT/ERP environment. 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for an experienced Senior Account Executive Accounts & Finance to manage day-to-day accounting operations, statutory compliances, reconciliations, MIS reporting, taxation, audit coordination and month-end/year-end closing activities. 
 The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Accounts & Finance, GST, TDS, statutory compliance, banking, reconciliations and MIS reporting , along with experience working on Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) and strong MS Excel skills. 
 Key Responsibilities Maintain books of accounts and accurately record financial transactions. Handle purchase, sales, expense, journal, cash and bank accounting entries. Manage Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable activities. Generate invoices, debit notes, credit notes and e-invoices. Monitor customer outstanding and follow up for payment collections. Handle vendor invoice verification, payments and vendor reconciliations. Perform daily Bank Reconciliation (BRS) and cash reconciliation. Manage petty cash and employee reimbursement/expense claims. Handle GST 2B reconciliation and vendor GST mismatch follow-ups. Assist with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and annual GST reconciliation. Prepare TDS workings and assist with TDS return filing, including 24Q/26Q. Perform 26AS reconciliation and coordinate TDS challan payments. Handle/verify PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, MLWF and other statutory compliances. Support gratuity workings and coordinate with external consultants. Assist internal and statutory auditors with schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents. Support month-end and year-end closing activities. Prepare MIS reports and Balance Sheet schedules. Maintain Fixed Asset Register and depreciation accounting. Handle advance and prepaid expense accounting. Assist in annual budgeting and prepare Budget vs. Actual reports. Support cash flow management and management reporting. Coordinate with CA, CS, bankers, auditors and government authorities. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation. Maintain confidentiality and ensure compliance with internal policies and SOPs. 
 Required Skills Minimum 5 years of experience in Accounts & Finance . Strong knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) is mandatory. Experience working in an IT Software / ERP environment will be preferred. Excellent knowledge of MS Excel , including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables and formulas. Strong understanding of GST, TDS, Income Tax and statutory compliance . Practical experience in GST return preparation and reconciliation. Experience in TDS return filing and 26AS reconciliation. Working knowledge of PF, ESIC, PT and LWF. description:
Job Summary Senior Account Manager - eProduct Renewals Are you a strategic renewals professional who excels at navigating complex negotiations and building trusted executive relationships Do you enjoy turning customer value into long-term partnerships while influencing commercial strategy and mentoring others This role owns the most commercially complex and highest-value accounts in the region. Where an Account Manager runs a defined renewal book, a Senior Account Manager carries the accounts where the outcome is not predictable: multi-site consortia, public tenders, competitive displacement attempts, contract restructurings, and accounts where the economic buyer has changed and the relationship has to be rebuilt from scratch. You will negotiate independently up to defined commercial thresholds, own the escalation strategy on at-risk revenue rather than handing it upward, and shape how the wider team approaches renewals through playbook contribution and deal coaching. You are the commercial lead; the Customer Success Manager owns adoption and value realization, and you convert that evidence into price and term. This is a senior individual contributor role with peer-leadership expectations. It does not carry direct reports. Position Details Territory: West India Reports to: Head of eSales, South Asia Southeast Asia Travel: Up to 50%, including intra-region and occasional global travel Responsibilities Own strategic renewals. Manage the region s largest, most complex and contested accounts, including public-sector, consortium, tender-led and channel-mediated renewals. Lead commercial negotiation. Negotiate price uplift, contract restructuring, product substitutions, tier migrations and multi-year terms within agreed thresholds. Maintain forecast discipline. Use MEDDPICC and Salesforce to qualify renewals, call risk early, and maintain accurate pipeline, value, stage and close-date data. Build senior stakeholder access. Engage economic buyers and senior institutional stakeholders, rebuilding relationships quickly when leadership changes. Convert value into renewal outcomes. Partner with CSMs to translate usage, adoption and business-review insights into commercial cases that support retention, uplift and expansion. Mitigate risk and grow whitespace. Identify at-risk revenue two quarters ahead of expiry, run documented save plans, and prioritize expansion where budget and product fit are strongest. Shape competitive positioning. Maintain regional market knowledge and prepare account-specific counter-positions against competing platforms and local alternatives. Represent customer voice. Escalate recurring feedback on content, relevance, user experience and integration to Product and Commercial Strategy with actionable detail. Requirements Proven experience in B2B commercial roles with significant experience in enterprise SaaS, digital content, subscription renewals, retention, or account management. Proven ownership of a scaled renewal book with measurable retention, price realization and expansion outcomes. Experience negotiating with institutional buying committees, procurement teams, public-sector authorities or channel partners. Strong command of structured sales methodology, preferably MEDDPICC, and disciplined Salesforce usage. Ability to build commercial cases using usage data, benchmark pricing, ROI evidence and customer value stories. Executive-level written and spoken English for senior correspondence and formal bid documentation. Experience in healthcare, health sciences education, medical publishing or clinical technology. Experience with distributors, public tenders, consortium purchasing or grant-funded institutional buying in South Asia or Southeast Asia.
